title: A Quiet Room for the First Term
transcript:
Hello, I'm moving to the city for a training course next month, and I saw your advertisement for a room. Could you tell me whether it is still available and what sort of household it is?
Yes, it is available. Three people live here, including me. Two work at the hospital and the other studies engineering. We share the kitchen, but everyone has their own cupboard and a shelf in the fridge.
That sounds suitable. I need somewhere quiet in the evening because most of my course preparation will be done at home. Is the advertised room the one looking over the main road?
That room has already been taken. The available one faces the garden, so traffic is less noticeable. It is smaller, though, and there is only room for a single bed and a desk.
A desk is essential, but I don't need much storage. What would I need to bring to secure it? I can show you my course acceptance letter when I come to view it.
The letter is helpful, but we also need a reference from your previous landlord. We don't ask for a payment until you have seen the room and we have both agreed on a moving date.
Good. The course starts on the ninth, although I could arrive the weekend before. Is there somewhere I can keep a bicycle? I would prefer cycling to buying a bus ticket every week.
There is a locked shed beside the house. You would have your own key. Please don't leave bicycles in the hallway, because it needs to remain clear for people carrying equipment to work.
I noticed that the rent includes heating and water. Does it include internet access as well, or would I need to organise that separately? Reliable access matters for the online sessions of my course.
Internet access is included, but electricity is divided between the four residents. We show everyone the bill, so you can see how the amount was calculated. The share usually changes a little between seasons.
Could I view the room tomorrow afternoon? I finish work at three and could be at the house around four, depending on the traffic near the station.
Four is fine. I will email the address and a photograph of the entrance. The house number is difficult to see from the pavement, so the photograph should make it easier to find.

questions.explanation: 门牌不易看清，入口照片帮助找房子。
